bayonet.songTitle: The Island: Come and See; The Landlord’s Daughter; You’ll Not Feel the Drowning
stanza: There's an island hidden in the sound
Lapping currents lay your boat aground
Affix your barb and bayonet
The curlews carve their Arabesques
And sorrow fills the silence all around
Come and see

bayonet.songTitle: Yankee Bayonet (I Will Be Home Then)
bayonet.line: This is the third song off of the Decemberist 2006 album ‘Crane Wife’. The song…
stanza: This is the third song off of the Decemberist 2006 album ‘Crane Wife’. The song…
A sweetheart left behind

internet.songTitle: When I Walk Out of the Museum

internet.line: I don't post no threats on the Internet
stanza: Look, I know killers, you no killer, huh?
Bathing Ape maybe not a gorilla, huh?
Glorified seat filler, huh?
Stop walkin' around like y'all made Thriller, huh?
Fake Dracos all in the videos
We show 'em, we shoot 'em in my city though
I don't post no threats on the Internet
I just pose a threat, blame Lenny S for that
I don't be on the 'Gram goin' ham
Givin' information to the pork, that's all spam
Please don't talk about guns that you ain't never gon' use
Y'all always tell on y'all self, I'm just so fuckin' confused

internet.line: But I need to get off the internet (Get off the internet)
internet.linePrev: And let it get the best of me 'til I snap ('Til I snap)
internet.lineNext: I need to get on the mic (Get on the mic)

internet.line: 'Cause we were like the mall before the internet
stanza: 'Cause we were like the mall before the internet
It was the one place to be
The mischief, the gift-wrapped suburban dreams
Sorry for not winning you an arcade ring
Over and over
Lost again with no surprises
Disappointments, close your eyes
And it gets colder and colder
When the sun goes down

inlet.line: I remember your silhouette on Dyes Inlet
stanza: I remember your silhouette on Dyes Inlet
Against the silver sheen of a moon like painted glass
Under stars out on a pier; a celestial sphere
We were weightless as the waves that disappeared

juliet.line: It was just that the time was wrong, Juliet?"
stanza: "Juliet, the dice was loaded from the start
And I bet, when you exploded into my heart
And I forget, I forget the movie song
When you gonna realize
It was just that the time was wrong, Juliet?"

juliet.lineNext: Teacher: You didn't know that was about love ‘til you saw it on TV and they sai…

stanza: (What did Romeo see in Juliet?)
(Or Pierrot in Pierrette?)
(Or Jupiter in Juno?)
You know!

parapet.line: We shared a clove cigarette on the parapet
stanza: We shared a clove cigarette on the parapet
As the TVs glowed from the windows of the model homes
And I'd never be that close again to your lips and perfect skin
As the tide receded into the unknown

sunset.line: I guess so you can watch the sunset
sunset.linePrev: And I poured out your ashes on it
sunset.lineNext: But the truth is I don't think of that dust as you

sunset.line: The day you flew off into the sunset
stanza: I didn't do too well at school
They said I couldn't concentrate
The day you flew off into the sunset
Was the day my education was saved
Then years later on Kensington High Street
I saw you drive a white convertible Golf GTI
Carefully edging out into the traffic
Just like a real live human being

sunset.line: I'll be the wind, the rain, and the sunset
stanza: I'll be your mirror
Reflect what you are, in case you don't know
I'll be the wind, the rain, and the sunset
The light on your door to show that you're home

sunset.songTitle: Two Suns In The Sunset (The Lockdown Sessions)
stanza: Two suns in the sunset
Could be the human race is run

sunset.line: Like he said into the sunset
stanza: Little Amsterdam shut down today
They buried her with a butter bean bouquet
And the Sheriff now can’t ride away
Like he said into the sunset
And I won’t say that he shouldn’t have paid
But, Momma, it wasn’t my bullet

sunset.line: And out of the tawny sunset
stanza: He did not come at the dawning
No, he did not come at the noon
And out of the tawny sunset
Before the rise of the moon
When the road was a gypsy's ribbon
Looping the purple moor
Oh a redcoat troop came marching, marching, marching
King George's men came marching
Up to the old inn door
December sunset
I can see my breath disappear in the cold winter night
Bums gathering driftwood down by the river
Whistle blows a lonesome cry

sunset.line: Their black feathers tinted in the sunset
sunset.lineNext: I knew these birds were omens but of what I wasn't sure

sunset.line: Was on a chair on top of a mountain pointed at the sunset
stanza: Another place I poured your ashes out
Was on a chair on top of a mountain pointed at the sunset
I went back there last week after a year has passed
And noticed the chunks of your bones that haven't been blown away
Are indistinguishable from the other pieces of animal bones
Brought there by coyotes, vultures, and gods
Against my will I felt a little bit of solace creeping in
But I laid there on the moss
Compost and memory:
There's nothing else
What I find
Will be found easily
And only when I'm not looking for it
Without looking for the morning
In the sunset
It's like this
That my will to live
Hides implied
In my heart beating
Without looking for fulfillment
But just accepting it
